description.value: Family-run lakefront campground on Christina Lake with 300 feet of sandy beach, swim dock, hot showers, and boat moorage — sites sit close together and facilities are self-described as old-school but clean, drawing loyal summer regulars for decades. Highway 3 access via a short paved lane makes it effortless to reach by bike.

raw_osm.description: Unforgettable lakefront camping at Skands Campground, the best Christina Lake campground. Family-friendly camping on the lake: RV hookups, free Wi-Fi, hot showers, boat moorage, and pet-friendly accommodations, all with  lake views. One of the best in BC.
raw_osm.name: Skands Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Skands Campground is a family-owned lakefront campground on Christina Lake operating since 1970, with tent and RV sites. Website explicitly confirms free hot showers (mentioned multiple times), free Wi-Fi, onsite laundry, sani-dump, dog-friendly policies, and a 'BOOK YOUR STAY' reservation system. OSM tag drinking_water=yes supplements water availability. The address '64 Johnson Road, Christina Lake, BC' is confirmed on both the FAQ page and OSM. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or most specialized cycling amenities. The campground is clearly active with no closure indicators.
concerns: Campground is heavily family- and RV-oriented; no specific mention of hiker/biker sites or cyclist accommodations
OSM access=customers indicates booking may be required in advance; walk-up availability for touring cyclists is unclear
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active lakefront campground accepting tent camping with showers, laundry, potable water, and Wi-Fi — useful amenities for touring cyclists on the Highway 3 corridor near Christina Lake.

wow_evidence: family-run lakefront campground on Christina Lake operating since 1970
